How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Research Associate-III Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree. Alternatively, an M.Sc/MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with 3 years of research or teaching experience and at least one SCI journal paper is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 67,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Research Associate-III in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-III role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview, which can be conducted either virtually or in-person.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable qualifications for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include experience in Systematic Reviews/Meta-analysis, knowledge of GRADE, and a background in Statistics/Epidemiology.
